preconditions.description: The number of rows in the board is between 1 and 100.
The number of columns in the board is between 1 and 100.
The length of the word is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(board[0]) for row in board)
preconditions.description: Each row in the board has the same number of columns as the other rows.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isalpha() for c in row) for row in board)
preconditions.description: All characters in the board are alphabetic letters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isalpha() for c in word) for word in [word])
preconditions.description: All characters in the word are alphabetic letters.

postconditions.description: The result is a boolean value.

postconditions.expression: result == (word in ''.join([''.join(row) for row in board]))
postconditions.description: The result is true if the word can be found in the board, considering adjacent cells only and no reuse of letters.
